meanings.name: sys_player_alt_idle_active
meanings.summary: Alternate-idle request: while the scratch flag is set the player stages the alternate idle animations of whatever form is current, and the shadow_shimmer actor stays in its fast-strip Active state.

effects.set: player_character stages anims $10-$13 (idle S/N/W/E), $2F / $2E (ladder idle south / north) and $35 / $34 (shimmy detach right / left); PlayerIdleAnimLoop stages $11; shadow_shimmer stays in ShadowShimmerActive while standing still.
effects.clear: The ordinary anims $00-$03, $2B / $2A, $31 / $30 and $01; shadow_shimmer returns to Idle when both speed words are zero.

meanings.notes: Every reader tests only this flag. None tests characterForm: StagePlayerSprite goes through SetActorBody, which picks the body from characterForm, and spriteset_will, spriteset_freedan and spriteset_shadow each hold real multi-frame animations at $10-$13, $2E / $2F and $34 / $35 (read in tables/spriteset_*.asm); ending_credits/sF7_credits_player stages the same animation indices. The shadow_shimmer actor does test the form (its guard dies when the form is not Shadow), which is probably where the name 'Shadow flag' came from. Writers: scene_flag_init (26 scenes, unconditional on the first tick) and the position or event triggers listed in _crossref. What the alternate pose depicts (a waiting or looking-around pose?) is not established: queue item FL30-01.

meanings.name: sys_inventory_exit_req
meanings.summary: The inventory overlay (scene $FF) is asked to close: inventory_menu sets the flag on Tab cancel and the overlay's main loop polls it.

effects.set: inventory_overlay leaves its UpdateFrameDialogue loop and runs the teardown (RestoreGameState).

meanings.notes: The overlay pushes eventFlags (flags $00-$0F) when it opens and zeroes it (inventory_overlay.asm lines 120-122, offsets 191788 and 191792), so the flag starts clear in the overlay and the world's value, including the alternate-idle flag $00 of the world scene, is restored on close (line 225). The producer and the consumer are in this scene only.

meanings.name: sys_palette_wave_req
meanings.summary: palette_parent_child polls the flag every frame: set spawns the child thinker that keeps stepping palette bundle #03 until the flag clears. No script of scenes $FD or $FF sets it.

effects.set: The parent spawns PaletteParentChildWaveLoop, waits for the flag to clear, kills the child and restarts bundle #03.
effects.clear: The parent only polls; bundle #03 is applied once at spawn.

meanings.notes: The thinker is spawned only in scenes $FD (statue ceremony, 253) and $FF (inventory overlay, 255). No actor of either scene sets $01 (inventory_menu and inventory_overlay use only $00; statue_inventory_reward uses SetFlagRaw with table indices $F8-$FD), scene setup clears $00-$0F, and the overlay zeroes eventFlags on open, so the spawn branch is not reachable in the shipped game: the child wave is dead code. Search: every inventory site with index $01 (184) and every file placed in those two scenes.
